promise: The 2011 Atomic Energy Act amendment scheduled the last nuclear shutdowns for the end of 2022.
description: Germany's 2011 legislation set December 31, 2022 as the final nuclear shutdown deadline. Temporary legislation extended the last three plants until April 15, 2023, when they shut down.
evidence: Federal ministry records confirm final shutdown on April 15, 2023.

description: Modi announced the aim of doubling farmers' income by 2022 at Bareilly on February 28, 2016.
evidence: The parliamentary record identifies the announcement and target.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked material does not establish a comparable national income baseline and deadline-year result.

promise: Cancel $10,000 of federal student loan debt per borrower ($20,000 for Pell Grant recipients).
description: Campaign pledge to cancel $10,000 in student debt, delivered via executive action announced August 24, 2022 with discharges intended before January 2023. The Supreme Court struck it down in Biden v. Nebraska (June 30, 2023, 6-3), and no mass cancellation occurred.
evidence: Aug 24, 2022 White House announcement of $10k/$20k cancellation
SCOTUS ruling in Biden v. Nebraska (June 30, 2023) blocked the program
Debt forgiveness never discharged before the ruling

review.note: Supreme Court ruling supports failure of the 2022 plan. Current wording combines 2020 campaign relief with later Pell-specific $20,000 terms. October 15 and year-end 2022 original deadline are not established; eligibility/income limits omitted.

promise: We will not sign any new oil or coal exploration contracts
description: In his inaugural address Petro promised to halt new oil and coal exploration contracts to accelerate Colombia's energy transition. His government followed through: the national hydrocarbon agency stopped signing new exploration contracts, and no new ones were awarded during his presidency despite pressure from industry and falling oil revenues.
evidence: ANH suspended new exploration contract rounds after Petro took office
No new exploration contracts signed through 2025-2026 despite fiscal pressure

review.note: Later reporting supports a ban on new hydrocarbon/mineral exploration contracts. Inauguration quote and December 2022 deadline unestablished; whether no new contracts were awarded throughout the presidency needs ANH register evidence. Ongoing contracts must be distinguished from new ones.

role: Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund
promise: We need to channel $100 billion of Special Drawing Rights from rich to vulnerable countries
description: The G20's $100 billion SDR-rechanneling ambition was reached in pledges by June 2023. IMF reported $103.4 billion pledged, which should not be described as actual disbursement.
evidence: IMF's ex-post assessment reports $103.4 billion pledged by June 2023.
sources: IMF press conference / G20 Rome summit statements (October-November 2021)
Reuters / Financial Times (2022-2024 SDR rechanneling tracking)

review.note: IMF says pledges reached $103.4bn by June 2023, not only ~$80bn by 2024. Pledges are not disbursements. October 31 attribution, 2022 deadline and $40bn actual on-lending need separate evidence.

promise: Hyperinflation is going to happen soon in the US and the world, and it will hit the poorest hardest
description: Dorsey tweeted that hyperinflation would hit the US and the world 'soon'. US inflation instead peaked at 9.1% in June 2022 (the highest in 40 years but nowhere near hyperinflation) and fell to roughly 3% by mid-2023. No hyperinflation occurred in the US or globally, and Bitcoin — which Dorsey linked to inflation hedging — fell about 75% from its Nov 2021 peak across 2022.
evidence: Tweet on @jack, April 2, 2022
US CPI peaked at 9.1% (June 2022) then declined to ~3% by mid-2023 — no hyperinflation
Global inflation also normalized through 2023

review.note: Contemporaneous coverage places hyperinflation tweets in October 2021, not April 2022. Need actual tweet timestamp for UTC and supplied tweet's contents. 'Soon' gives no year-end deadline; global claim and Bitcoin performance are peripheral and unverified.

description: Netflix later reversed its no-third-party-advertising stance by launching an advertising-supported plan, including US availability from November 3, 2022.
evidence: Netflix's launch announcement confirms advertising-supported service in November 2022.

review.note: Contemporaneous no-ad report was June 1, not June 30. Netflix confirms US ad tier November 3, 2022 (Canada November 1). No explicit 2022 deadline for indefinite stance was established.

promise: NVIDIA's $40 billion acquisition of Arm (announced Sept 2020) expected to close by early 2022
description: NVIDIA and SoftBank terminated the proposed Arm acquisition in February 2022 because of regulatory challenges. Their agreement had been announced in September 2020.
evidence: NVIDIA's termination release confirms the transaction did not close.

review.note: NVIDIA confirms September 13, 2020 announcement, not June 30, and termination in February 2022. Newsroom February 7 versus earnings February 8 likely needs UTC reconciliation. Early-2022 expectation does not justify December deadline; remove unsupported superlative.

promise: CNN+ will be the next generation of CNN — a premium streaming subscription service for news (as reported).
description: CNN+ launched on March 29, 2022. Warner Bros. Discovery announced its closure on April 21; announcement and final service shutdown were different dates.
evidence: April 21 reporting described cessation as forthcoming, not already completed.

review.note: April 21 was shutdown announcement, not actual cessation. Original November 17 quote/deadline and final shutdown day need source; a pledge to launch differs from a promise of commercial longevity. CNN page also has an apparent 2021 dateline typo despite 2022 heading.

person: COP26 signatories of the Statement on International Public Support for the Clean Energy Transition
promise: COP26 signatories committed to end new direct public support for the international unabated fossil-fuel energy sector by the end of 2022, subject to limited Paris-aligned exceptions.
description: The commitment concerns international public support across unabated fossil fuels, not only coal. It preserves limited, clearly defined exceptions consistent with the Paris goals.
evidence: Contemporary November 4, 2021 coverage establishes the announcement and end-2022 target.
The statement preserves exceptions and distinguishes the deadline for original COP26 signers.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked sources do not audit financing decisions across all original signatories.

promise: Shut down all German nuclear power plants by 2022 (decision of 30 May 2011).
description: Post-Fukushima, Germany pledged to close all reactors by end-2022. The last three units (Emsland, Isar 2, Neckarwestheim 2) had to be extended through the winter due to the energy crisis and were finally shut down on 15 April 2023 - ~3.5 months past the statutory deadline.
evidence: Wikipedia Nuclear power in Germany: final three plants 'shut down on 15 April 2023', extended by Scholz decree in late 2022
Eight of seventeen reactors had closed by August 2011; the phase-out was broadly achieved with a short delay

review.note: Last commercial reactors closed 15 April 2023 after a legislated extension beyond end-2022. Full completion after the original deadline is kept (delayed), not partial. Exact May 2011 pledge day was not independently established here.

promise: India will install 175 GW of renewable energy by 2022, including 100 GW of solar.
description: India's 2022 target covered 175 GW of renewable capacity excluding large hydropower, including 100 GW solar. A parliamentary committee reported 120.90 GW installed by 31 December 2022, about 69% of the target.
evidence: The NITI Aayog roadmap sets out the 175 GW target and technology components.
Parliamentary committee coverage reports 120.90 GW by the deadline.

review.note: The target excludes large hydro; mixing broad renewable totals changes the apparent shortfall. Parliamentary-report coverage gives 120.90 GW at 31 December 2022. Exact COP21 wording/day and later 100 GW solar milestone remain unverified.

promise: Lagarde said an ECB rate increase during 2022 was very unlikely under its forward-guidance conditions (paraphrased forecast).
description: In Lisbon on November 3, 2021, Lagarde described a 2022 rate increase as very unlikely under the ECB's forward-guidance conditions.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the retrieved speech record establishes the forecast, but the original cumulative-hike figures were not reconciled against ECB decisions.

promise: Nov-Dec 2022 (post-FTX collapse): Binance would publish proof of reserves and complete a full independent audit 'in coming weeks' (by end of 2022)
description: Only partial self-reported Merkle-tree proof with Mazars' limited verification (Dec 7, 2022); Mazars suspended crypto work Dec 16, 2022 and no full audit was ever delivered
evidence: Retained from the existing collection; outcome evidence remains to be documented.
sources: CZ tweets, Nov 2022; Binance PoR announcement
Reuters, 'Mazars pauses work for crypto firms including Binance'

review.note: Mazars' limited proof-of-reserves work and December 16 suspension are documented. No retrieved evidence establishes CZ promised a full financial audit by a specific 2022 date. The 2020 announcement, December 28 deadline and unlimited claim that no audit was ever delivered remain unverified.

promise: May 2022: SEC would finalize its climate-disclosure rule 'by the end of the year' (2022)
description: The SEC adopted climate-disclosure rules on 6 March 2024. On 27 March 2025 it voted to end its defense of those rules in court; that vote did not rescind them.
evidence: SEC's March 2025 release identifies the March 2024 adoption and the decision to end legal defense.
sources: Reuters/WSJ reports of Gensler's timing, May 2022
SEC press releases: final rule Apr 4, 2024 (sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2024-31); rescission Mar 27, 2025

review.note: Rule adopted March 6, 2024, not April. March 27, 2025 action ended litigation defense; it was not rescission. Claimed May 2022 year-end promise and 2020 date remain unsupported; no safe replacement for those fields.

promise: Donate 1 billion COVID-19 vaccine doses to poorer countries by the end of 2022
description: The Carbis Bay communique combined direct donations and financing to provide one billion doses over the following year, including commitments made since February 2021. Oxfam's June 2022 assessment reported delivery shortfalls against a larger aggregate of national pledges; the denominators and deadlines should not be conflated.
evidence: Oxfam/People's Vaccine Alliance: only 49% of promised G7 donations delivered by June 2022
UK delivered 39% of its pledged 100 million doses by its end-of-month deadline
Institute for Global Change found less than a third of G7 pledges reached Africa by mid-2022

review.note: Communique describes one billion doses over the next year, including commitments made since February 2021, not uniformly by end-2022. Oxfam's 49% concerns a different 2.1-billion-dose aggregate measured in June 2022, and acknowledges some national deadlines had not arrived. It cannot establish the record's end-2022 broken verdict.

promise: Nikola Badger pickup would enter production in 2022 or earlier, with the truck built from the ground up by Nikola
description: Milton promoted the Badger before Nikola announced its GM agreement on September 8, 2020. The July 2021 indictment alleged that he misrepresented the truck's development and prototype origins; the GM announcement did not occur alongside the June promotion.
evidence: US DOJ indictment (July 2021) alleged false statements about the Badger and its reservations
GM deal collapsed November 2020; Badger cancelled; no production vehicles ever built

review.note: Indictment distinguishes June promotion from the September 8, 2020 GM announcement. Its prototype claims are allegations in this source, not a substitute for a verdict. Exact June 9 production commitment and deadline remain unverified.

promise: Expect Full Self-Driving to become safer than a human driver in 2022
description: Musk forecast a 2022 safety milestone. Driver supervision alone is not a comparative collision-risk measurement.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: no matched, independently validated 2022 comparison establishing the stated safety threshold was located.
